prompt: For a workspace governance check, can you tell me what reactions were left on the message where someone asked about grabbing AWS p5 instance time for the circuit-tracer workload — that message is in the channel where one of our workspace admins sits as a member?
binding_note: The reaction must attach to the specific message about p5/supercomputer time for circuit-tracer, and that message's conversation must have a membership record for a user who also holds an admin or owner role on that workspace's membership table; no channel/member/message combination in the data satisfies all three jointly with an actual reaction present.

roles.facts: The engineering channel (#engineering), which contains the target message and also has Robert Walsh as a member.

roles.reason: Conversation-membership link satisfying the route between the conversation and a user who is a workspace admin.

obligations.name: reactions_on_supercomputer_message
obligations.description: Find reactions attached to the message about getting p5 supercomputer time for circuit-tracer, where that message's channel has a member holding an admin/owner workspace role.
obligations.scope: reactions on the single identified message within the admin-linked #engineering channel

task_spec.text: Identify the message about seeking AWS p5 supercomputer time for circuit-tracer in the channel that includes an admin/owner-level workspace member, and report any reactions on it.

access_plan: Locate the message via conversations.history/search.messages on '#engineering' (or a workspace-wide search for 'supercomputer'/'p5'), confirm channel membership via conversations.members, cross-check the admin/owner role of that member via users.info or the workspace membership record, then call reactions.get on the identified message's channel/timestamp to enumerate any reactions.
